info.name: SaveUsersDev
info.description: Dev-only API to seed M_Users. POST /api/SaveUserName looks up role_name in M_Role; if missing returns 400 'Role not found', else hashes the plain-text password with BCrypt (factor 12, same as AIM's AuthenticationService) and inserts into M_Users with the resolved RoleId.

request.description:
username -> M_Users.UserName (unique)
password -> plain text in, BCrypt-hashed before storing
email_address -> M_Users.EmailAddress
role_name -> must exist in M_Role.RoleName (seeded: Admin, User)
role_name does not exist in M_Role -> expect 400 { "error": "Role not found" }
